answer: A mechanism that actually bites: let the challenge probing adapt: it keeps issuing tasks the fleet already failed, because grove only stays cheap while repeat infrastructure gets no useful signal and its pass rate degrades each epoch. Concretely, glacier is enforced in the ledger: Every gate is public and recomputable, so honest agents can verify they were treated fairly. Any opal approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That converts sybil attacks from an economic play into a pure loss.
